headline: Fishermans Row and Lykos Isle Trade Strongholds Again
war_summary: Since the last edition, Fishermans Row has not gone quiet: ten strategic-base events in the past two hours, thirty-eight on the day, with Fort Ember, Arcadia, and Peripti Landing among the most frequently touched positions. Lykos Isle is likewise still in motion, with five events in two hours and fourteen on the day, led by Mārudia, Fort Guile, and Cyrus. Weathered Expanse remains active as well—two events in the latest two-hour window, nine on the day, most often at Spirit Watch and Foxcatcher—and its 24-hour losses are enormous: more than twenty thousand Colonial and twenty-three thousand Warden casualties. Stlican Shelf has re-emerged as a contested sector, registering one flip in the past two hours and eight on the day at Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn. DeadLands, quiet in the previous edition's recent windows, now shows two fresh events at The Salt March and Callahan's Boot. Farranac Coast has produced no flips in the past two hours but retains eleven on the day, concentrated around Mara and Terra.
